business_problem: AES needed to scale health and safety audits, reduce the time and cost of each audit, and keep a secure human-in-the-loop process while adopting generative AI in a regulated operating environment.
solution_summary: AES built a generative-AI audit environment on Google Cloud using Gemini platform and Anthropic Claude models to automate large portions of safety-review work. Gemini platform provides the secure managed environment for deploying and coordinating the audit agents, while Claude is called through Gemini platform APIs to handle the reasoning-heavy portions of the process. This approach solved security concerns around permissions and service-account management and gave AES a way to synchronize multiple agents across complex audit steps without building a new runtime from scratch. Human reviewers remain in the loop for final examination, but the AI agents now handle much of the repetitive evidence gathering and report generation. The result is a significantly faster, cheaper, and more accurate audit workflow that also lays a foundation for future predictive and maintenance-focused AI use cases across energy operations.
